boundary: The isomorphism is for the section stabilizer K. It is not an M24-equivariant splitting of G24, and the two full-rank intertwiners show a residual one-bit ambiguity rather than a unique coordinate identification.
theorem: The six-dimensional Golay glue quotient G24/C6 is K-equivariantly isomorphic to the binary permutation module on the six sextet tetrads. Thus the 64 Construction-A glue cosets carry the sextet tetrad permutation geometry.
